why: Searches turned up active 2024-2025 literature on Reinhardt cardinals and elementary embeddings (e.g. Mohammd 2025 on eventually dominating functions, Goldberg-Hou on indescribable ideals under a Reinhardt cardinal, Jeon 2024 on cofinal Reinhardt embeddings without powerset) but these all study consequences assuming such an embedding exists, or alternate proofs of the ZFC Kunen inconsistency; none resolve whether a nontrivial j:V→V is consistent with ZF alone, which multiple sources explicitly still describe as open.
queries: Reinhardt cardinal ZF elementary embedding V to V proof 2025
nontrivial elementary embedding V→V without axiom of choice solved

found.title: Reinhardt Cardinals and Eventually Dominating Functions
found.note: Proves results in ZF(j) assuming a Reinhardt embedding exists; also gives another proof of the Kunen inconsistency (which uses choice); does not address consistency without choice.

found.title: On a Cofinal Reinhardt Embedding Without Powerset
found.note: Studies a weakened (powerset-free) variant of Reinhardt embeddings, not the stated V→V question.
